# Browser animation libraries

These unmodified browser distributions are hosted locally to keep the animation sequence independent of third-party script loading.

- GSAP 3.15.0: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP — license: https://gsap.com/standard-license
- ScrollTrigger 3.15.0, distributed with GSAP under the same license.
- Barba core 2.10.3: https://github.com/barbajs/barba — MIT license.
- Lenis 1.3.27: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis — MIT license.

The copyright and license notices in each distribution are preserved. The `package.json` records the pinned versions; the portfolio remains buildless in the browser.
